(7) The gate cannot see it: scripts/check-bidi-glyphs.mjs:13-16 states in its own header it does NOT catch the two-adjacent-numbers reorder shape. verdict.reason:
Tried to refute on three fronts; two of the lens's supports fell, the finding itself did not.

1) The probe evidence is INVALID and should not be re-used. `scratchpad/results/lensB-finance/pass-3.json` `m09.*.visual` is a naive full-string reversal, not a UBA rendering: it turns the LRI-isolated `⁦2,899 ₪⁩` into `⁦₪ 998,2⁩`, `⁦580⁩ ימים` into `⁦085⁩`, and `⁦DSO⁩` into `⁦OSD⁩` — all three of which render correctly in a real browser. So the lens's quoted `09+` / `16–09` strings are artifacts, and its wording ('מדרג +90') was not read off that file.

2) The finding nevertheless reproduces on the real screenshots, and worse than claimed. Cropped and enlarged from the lens's own captures (browser, not a model):
 · `m09-bidi-zoom.png` level-0 tile header renders `מדרג +90` (plus sign to the LEFT of the digits) — logical source `…i1_rpc_formats_and_notes.sql:1013` `'label','מדרג 90+'`.
 · `m09-level1-from-tile.png` crumb renders `גיול חובות | מדרג +90 יום` — logical source the same file, `:760` `when 'd90p' then 'מדרג 90+ יום'`.
 · Decisive, and the lens only PREDICTED it: `m09-mode0.png`, level-0 table, מדרג column — every row of the 1–30 bucket prints **`30–1`**, not `1–30`. The reversed range is already live on screen, not a future risk. Same UBA path will print `90–61` for `:759` `'מדרג 61–90 יום'` (U+2013 between two ENs resolves to R under N1, so the two digit runs swap).

3) No recorded ruling covers it and it is not a routed duplicate. §9 D-26 / the H2 migration (`20260916085900_module11_h2_sentence_isolation.sql`) isolated only `n=` and thousands separators, and its own header lists explicitly what it deliberately left bare (m14/m15 `n=`) — bucket labels are not there. §9 D-32 shows the מ9 מדרג column was only just switched from raw keys (`d90p`) to these labels, so the mirroring is a consequence of that fix, unruled. `grep` for `90+` / `61–90` / `ומעלה` in `docs/micro_guides/module-11.md` returns only data-derivation notes (:440) and D-32 (:704). Nothing in the KNOWN-ISSUES list touches מ9 labels (the מ21 ASCII-hyphen item is a different string, already fixed).

Owner is rpc, not the tab: the tile/crumb/level-name strings are mixed Hebrew+Latin built in SQL, so only the RPC can isolate the right substring; the tab's `FORMATTERS.text` (`src/lib/reportsFormat.js:124`) is a bare `String(v)` and cannot know which run to wrap. Precedent is already in the repo both ways — H2 fixed server sentences in SQL, and `formatWindowLabel` (`reportsFormat.js:217`) isolates `from–to` as ONE unit for exactly this reason.

Severity stays major: user-visible wrong-reading labels on all three levels plus the export caption, no data error and no crash.
verdict.fix_hint: Forward migration on `report_m09_aging`: wrap only the numeric run in `chr(8294)…chr(8297)` (the H2 `n=` pattern) — bucket column values `1–30`/`31–60`/`61–90`/`90+`, `tiles[].label` `'מדרג 90+'`, and the level names `'מדרג 61–90 יום'`/`'מדרג 90+ יום'` that feed the crumb and the export caption; isolate each range as a single unit, never two isolates.
